snippet.title: Easy Joe World - Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Get it on Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.com.spilgames.EasyJoeWorld
Get it on iOs: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/easy-joe-world/id1088306856?mt=8
Joe can use some excitement! Hop on and take-it-easy on an adventure with Joe the rabbit. Explore and solve various fun, humor-filled and funny point-and-click puzzles.
Take a short break or two and hop along with Joe as he encounters various tricky traps, outrageous obstacles and fool many cool creatures. His epic journey will provide you with a mental workout too. Can you come up with clever solutions that will help him keep bouncing along?

A retro romp:
Easy Joe will transport you back to an era of gaming when the Atari 2600 was still considered cutting-edge. Its old-school graphics are as cute as they are timeless and they’re similar to the ones featured in early ‘80s platformers. The puzzles you’ll solve with Joe are a lot more funny than the ones you’ll find in those old games though. They’re faster to complete as well, which means that Easy Joe will keep you entertained during your commute, lunch break or any other time when you have a few minutes to kill. See if you can help the bunny sail across lakes, sneak past guard dogs and even use a helicopter to, literally, raise the roof!

Key features: 
- Simple controls (Easy Joe is definitely easy to play). 
- Over 100 fun brainteasers and puzzles. 
- A humorous, retro-style world for you to explore. 
- You can play it anytime, anywhere on your smartphone, tablet or PC.

De-stress from your busy day with this bodacious bunny! Joe is about to begin his quest. Are you ready to help him stay safe? With you keeping an eye on him, he’s sure to come back home with tons of great tales for all of his furry foes and friends!
